notes: Kit's cards in your chat are redrawn: every card names your kit, receipts and recalls sit on one line that opens for more, and each card has its own sky of fireflies.
Your kit's wake card now shows how it is doing beside the greeting, with memory, capture and backups each saying when they were last checked.
The sleep chart on the wake card grows day by day, and a small moon settles on each night, coloured by how the dream went, with last night's stages underneath.
Cards only show buttons and links your chat app can actually use, and a card from earlier in a conversation says so instead of waiting for ever.
